title: Custom bosses
description: custom bosses to the game, and custom commands to work with the plugin
body: A cool Paper plugin that adds cutsom boss maker to put new bosses into your server! Only server operators are permitted to use the cutsom bosses commands. Using the custom bosses editor, you can create custom bosses to go with your server! The plugin is designed to be easy and simple to use. The plugin adds many different ways to make the bosses such as: Changeing the name, and name color, the boss attacks, the bosses skin (what mob it is), and the amount of damage and health,  it also features a custom drop system!
